---
title: "4 - Build Web Artifacts"
format: html
jupyter: python3
---

This step publishes the canonical processed ATO and VMT artifacts into the Vite
app's static data folder. Files in `_site/public/data/` are served directly by
the browser at runtime.

This step does not recompute metrics or PMTiles. Run `2-process-ato-layers.qmd`
and `3-process-vmt-layers.qmd` first when raw data has changed.

```{python}
from _src import process_ato, process_vmt

expected_files = [
    process_ato.PROCESSED_DIR / "manifest.json",
    process_ato.PROCESSED_DIR / process_ato.METRICS_FILENAME,
    process_ato.PROCESSED_DIR / process_ato.FILL_PMTILES_FILENAME,
    process_ato.PROCESSED_DIR / process_ato.BOUNDARY_PMTILES_FILENAME,
    process_vmt.PROCESSED_DIR / "manifest.json",
    process_vmt.PROCESSED_DIR / process_vmt.METRICS_FILENAME,
    process_vmt.PROCESSED_DIR / process_vmt.FILL_PMTILES_FILENAME,
    process_vmt.PROCESSED_DIR / process_vmt.BOUNDARY_PMTILES_FILENAME,
]

missing = [path for path in expected_files if not path.exists()]
if missing:
    missing_text = "\n".join(f"  - {path}" for path in missing)
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "Missing processed artifacts. Run steps 2 and 3 first.\n"
        f"{missing_text}"
    )

publish_summary = {
    "ato": process_ato.publish_web_assets(),
    "vmt": process_vmt.publish_web_assets(),
}
publish_summary
```

After this step, the Vite app can load both ATO and VMT manifests, Parquet
metrics, and PMTiles from `_site/public/data/`.
